import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static final int MAXN = 410;
    static final int MAXM = 200020;
    static final int GS = 12;
    static final int[] mx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static final int[] my = {0, 1, 0, -1};

    static char[][] gridA = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] gridB = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] safeTime = new int[GS][GS];
    static int[][] fastTime = new int[GS][GS];
    static int n, timeLimit;

    static boolean inside(int x, int y) {
        return x >= 0 && x < n && y >= 0 && y < n;
    }

    static void zombieBfs(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < GS; i++) Arrays.fill(safeTime[i], 0x3f3f3f3f);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(sx * 10 + sy);
        safeTime[sx][sy] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur / 10, y = cur % 10;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = x + mx[k], ny = y + my[k];
                if (inside(nx, ny) && gridA[nx][ny] >= '0' && gridA[nx][ny] <= '9' && safeTime[nx][ny] > safeTime[x][y] + 1) {
                    safeTime[nx][ny] = safeTime[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(nx * 10 + ny);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void playerBfs(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < GS; i++) Arrays.fill(fastTime[i], 0x3f3f3f3f);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(sx * 10 + sy);
        fastTime[sx][sy] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur / 10, y = cur % 10;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = x + mx[k], ny = y + my[k];
                if (inside(nx, ny) && gridB[nx][ny] >= '0' && gridB[nx][ny] <= '9' && fastTime[nx][ny] > fastTime[x][y] + 1) {
                    if (safeTime[nx][ny] >= fastTime[x][y] + 1) {
                        fastTime[nx][ny] = fastTime[x][y] + 1;
                        if (safeTime[nx][ny] > fastTime[nx][ny])
                            q.add(nx * 10 + ny);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static class Dinic {
        int[] head, to, nxt, cap, flow;
        int[] level, cur;
        int ecnt, s, t;

        Dinic() {
            head = new int[MAXN];
            to = new int[MAXM];
            nxt = new int[MAXM];
            cap = new int[MAXM];
            flow = new int[MAXM];
            level = new int[MAXN];
            cur = new int[MAXN];
            init();
        }

        void init() {
            Arrays.fill(head, -1);
            ecnt = 0;
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
            to[ecnt] = v;
            nxt[ecnt] = head[u];
            cap[ecnt] = c;
            flow[ecnt] = 0;
            head[u] = ecnt++;

            to[ecnt] = u;
            nxt[ecnt] = head[v];
            cap[ecnt] = 0;
            flow[ecnt] = 0;
            head[v] = ecnt++;
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            level[s] = 0;
            q.add(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (int e = head[u]; e != -1; e = nxt[e]) {
                int v = to[e];
            if (level[v] == -1 && cap[e] > flow[e]) {
                level[v] = level[u] + 1;
                q.add(v);
            }
        }
    }
    return level[t] != -1;
}

int dfs(int u, int a) {
    if (u == t || a == 0) return a;
    int ret = 0;
    for (int e = cur[u]; e != -1; e = nxt[e]) {
        int v = to[e];
        if (level[v] == level[u] + 1 && cap[e] > flow[e]) {
            int f = dfs(v, Math.min(a, cap[e] - flow[e]));
            if (f > 0) {
                flow[e] += f;
                flow[e ^ 1] -= f;
                a -= f;
                ret += f;
                if (a == 0) break;
            }
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

int maxflow(int S, int T) {
    s = S;
    t = T;
    int ans = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        System.arraycopy(head, 0, cur, 0, head.length);
        ans += dfs(s, INF);
    }
    return ans;
}
}

public static void main(String[] args) {
    Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
    n = sc.nextInt();
    timeLimit = sc.nextInt();
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        String s = sc.next();
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) gridA[i][j] = s.charAt(j);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        String s = sc.next();
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) gridB[i][j] = s.charAt(j);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
            if (gridA[i][j] == 'Z')
                zombieBfs(i, j);

    int S = 0, T = n * n * 2 + 1;
    Dinic flow = new Dinic();

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            if (gridA[i][j] > '0' && gridA[i][j] <= '9')
                flow.addEdge(S, i * n + j + 1, gridA[i][j] - '0');
            if (gridB[i][j] > '0' && gridB[i][j] <= '9')
                flow.addEdge(n * n + i * n + j + 1, T, gridB[i][j] - '0');
        }

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
            if (gridA[i][j] > '0' && gridA[i][j] <= '9') {
                playerBfs(i, j);
                for (int x = 0; x < n; x++)
                    for (int y = 0; y < n; y++)
                        if (gridB[x][y] > '0' && gridB[x][y] <= '9' && fastTime[x][y] <= timeLimit)
                            flow.addEdge(i * n + j + 1, n * n + x * n + y + 1, INF);
            }

    System.out.println(flow.maxflow(S, T));
}
}
